responsibility: Implements GCC’s broad collection of RTL analysis helpers used across the backend. Beyond general predicates and value/bit-property queries, this file provides the subrtx-iterator machinery implementation, analyzes defs/uses and addressing structure, decomposes MEM and LEA addresses into base/index/displacement forms, detects symbolic, TLS, and constant-pool references, adds REG_INC notes for auto-increment memory operands, and supplies vector-select highpart/lowpart recognition and many other reusable RTL inspection routines.
same_name_distinction: Holds the main implementation body for RTL analysis, address decomposition, subrtx iteration support, reference/predicate helpers, and note/address utilities, whereas gcc/rtlanal.h only introduces newer analysis-specific abstractions such as rtx_obj_reference/rtx_properties and a small subset of declarations.
